Cajón de bebidas

A dedicated sliding compartment in the aircraft galley for storing drinks, ice, and related service items, accessible to cabin crew during flight.

What is Cajón de bebidas?

In this glossary, Cajón de bebidas refers to: A dedicated sliding compartment in the aircraft galley for storing drinks, ice, and related service items, accessible to cabin crew during flight.

How is Cajón de bebidas used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tripulación, asegúrense de que todos los cajones de bebidas estén cerrados y asegurados antes del rodaje y despegue."
